correctness.rationale: Every covariance entry follows from a complete classification of identical, incident, and disjoint unordered edges and the deterministic partition of all pairs by circular distance. The finite-population four-point moment expansion yields Λ=n(v−2w+z); the squared-difference representation verifies nonnegativity and its complete degeneracy boundary. Orthogonal decomposition verifies the full even/odd spectra. Under algebraic independence, polynomial coefficient comparison makes each score fiber exactly a graph-automorphism orbit; wreath-product automorphism counts give every support and atom mass. The independently executed standalone code passed 737 exact assertions, exhaustively enumerating all permutations through n=8 and the three-valued degeneracy multisets through n=12. Infinite quantifiers are proved analytically, not inferred from finite tests.

originality.rationale: The inspected middle-period primary paper establishes permutation-test theory for ordinary autocorrelations without the finite circular all-lag covariance/support classification. Zhou et al. 2013 already provide general raw permutation quadratic-form moments; the finding does NOT present those moments as new. The distinct contribution is a complete, generic exact atom census for every lag and the demonstration that gcd-dependent support differs sharply despite data-independent equicorrelations, including parity-sensitive full covariance eigenspaces. Moment methods cannot imply support count without substantial independent orbit work. No published-record or recoverable accessible prior claim directly covers the complete assertion. Older permutation and orbit literature leaves historical-priority risk.

value.rationale: The all-lag finite-sample randomization null for circular autocorrelation is a natural object for exact serial-dependence tests. Its complete covariance spectrum gives explicit calibration for arbitrary observed real data, while the exact generic orbit support gives attainable permutation p-value granularity that moments cannot reveal. At length n=9, lags 1 and 3 have identical variance yet respectively 20,160 versus 280 support points, a factor of 72 in tail resolution. This is a motivated complete classification rather than an arbitrary isolated parameter slice; the exact gcd dependence and even/odd covariance mode are structural and may affect selection of lag tests. No claim of improved power, limiting distribution, or broader downstream theorem is made.
